title: Brand new -- stops making HOT coffee
text:
Brand new -- stops making HOT coffee. We bought this unit to replace a heavily used similar West Bend unit whose on/off switch became damaged. After about a month the coffee is no longer hot....tepid at best. A call to West Bend brought no joy about replacing or repairing the unit so I am pulling the heating element from the old unit and putting it in the new one.

Overall this is a great concept -- good volume, easy to use -- but at least our unit is a poor performer.
